limitations: The Reachable pill (all three checks passing) needs an HTTPS BASE_URL with a public IPv4 record; the labs are loopback only, so only the Not reachable states were observed (HTTPS scheme and Public IPv4 address on 127.0.0.1 and the LAN address; IPv4 record as well on http://[::1]).
Expired keys were produced as fixture setup by moving the walkthrough's own api_keys row expiry into the past in the lab database. Expired OAuth grants were not produced; revoked grants were.

The V-M42-MCP upgrade used the operator's own docker compose commands against the owned mcpup project (upgrade.sh). A first attempt extracted the target under the script's umask 077 and the built app could not read its own packages; nothing had migrated, the script's rollback stage restarted the 067c1646 images and the phase was repeated with the extraction under umask 022 (runs.m42up.earlierAttempt).
Modern and legacy Clients were script Clients from the SDK in node_modules; no vendor Client was connected. The modern Client negotiated 2026-07-28, the legacy Client 2025-11-25.

The OAuth reachability note under the group rows reads 'OAuth Clients work only if this server is reachable from the internet.' The guide does not quote it; the author's productBugs entry about its wording stands.
Record activity 'via the named Client' attribution for writes was not walked; the registry does not require it.
